# justingreenbaum.com

> Personal site of Justin R. Greenbaum — enterprise strategy and operations executive, former Comcast Vice President, and founder of Greenbaum Labs. 20+ years leading customer, service-delivery, trust, regulatory, partner, and transformation operations. Now building Decision & Responsibility Infrastructure (DRI) — evidence systems that make organizational conditions observable.

## About Justin
- Enterprise strategy and operations executive (2005–present); Comcast frontline to Vice President
- Founder, Greenbaum Labs — independent applied-AI lab running on owned infrastructure
- MIT Sloan AI Executive Academy, NVIDIA infrastructure training, Prosci Certified Change Practitioner
- Creator of the Coherence diagnostic framework

## Core Concepts
- **Coherence Triangle:** Truth (center-edge alignment), Authority (signal strength), Continuity (temporal consistency)
- **Decision & Responsibility Infrastructure (DRI):** Designing structural conditions where good decisions and clear accountability are the default
- **Failure Modes:** Taxonomy of 17 structural failure patterns in organizations (FM-01 through FM-17)
- **Functional Field Notes:** 21 early-warning observations from diagnostic fieldwork
